question: Which company has the Indian Navy signed the deal with for design & development of medium-speed marine diesel engine?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian Navy signs deal for design & development of medium-speed marine diesel engine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Project Sanction Order Signed:** The Indian Navy has signed the project sanction order under the Make-I category with Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited for the design and development of a 6-megawatt marine diesel engine.

 
 
• 
 
**Indigenous Content:** The prototype diesel engine will have over 50% indigenous content.

 
 
• 
 
**Cost and Funding:** The development of the diesel engine will cost 270 crore rupees, with 70% of the funding provided by the government.

 
 
• 
 
**Additional Development:** The project also includes the design and development of a 3-10 MW diesel engine.

 
 
• 
 
**Usage:** The developed diesel engines will be used for main propulsion and power generation on ships of the Indian Navy and Indian Coast Guard.

 
 
• 
 
**Location:** The project sanction order was signed in New Delhi.
